=== .gitlab-ci.yml (stages-yaml)
# Imported from .gitlab-ci.yml by launchway import pipeline. The old files are untouched.
# Read the findings it printed: lines marked NEEDS A PERSON below are not converted.
pipeline: ci
on:
  push: {branches: ['*'], tags: ['*']}
  pull_request: {}
defaults:
  env: {GOFLAGS: -mod=readonly, APP: shop}
containers:
  unit: {image: 'golang:1.22'}
  unit-db:
    image: postgres:16
    service: true
    env: {POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test}
steps:
  build:
    image: golang:1.22
    timeout: 1h30m
    retry: 1
    env:
      npm_config_cache: .cache/npm
    run: |
      echo "start $LAUNCHWAY_STEP"
      go build ./...
      echo $LAUNCHWAY_COMMIT > sha.txt
    cache:
      - {name: cache-go-mod, paths: [.cache/go-mod, .cache/npm], key: {files: [go.sum], text: gomod}}
    artifacts:
      - {name: binaries, paths: [bin], retain: 1w, when: always}
  lint:
    image: golang:1.22
    needs: build
    when: {branch: main, event: pull_request, upstream: failed}
    timeout: 20m
    retry: 1
    run: |
      golangci-lint run
    fetch:
      - {from: build, name: binaries}
  unit:
    container: unit
    needs: build
    when: {branch: main, event: pull_request}
    timeout: 1h30m
    retry: 1
    on_failure: continue
    run: |
      echo "start $LAUNCHWAY_STEP"
      go test ./... -coverprofile=cover.out
      echo "start $LAUNCHWAY_STEP"
      echo done
    reports:
      tests: [report.xml]
      coverage: [coverage.xml]
    fetch:
      - {from: build, name: binaries}
  shards:
    image: golang:1.22
    needs: build
    timeout: 1h30m
    retry: 1
    for_each:
      node-index: ["1", "2", "3"]
    env:
      CI_NODE_INDEX: {each: node-index}
      CI_NODE_TOTAL: "3"
    run: |
      ./run-shard.sh $CI_NODE_INDEX/$CI_NODE_TOTAL
    fetch:
      - {from: build, name: binaries}
  versions:
    image: python:3.12
    needs: build
    timeout: 1h30m
    retry: 1
    for_each:
      python: ["3.11", "3.12"]
      db: [pg]
    env:
      PYTHON: {each: python}
      DB: {each: db}
    run: |
      pytest --py $PYTHON
    fetch:
      - {from: build, name: binaries}
  release-approval:
    kind: approval
    needs: build
    message: Run release?
  release:
    image: golang:1.22
    needs: [release-approval, build]
    when: {tag: v*}
    timeout: 1h30m
    retry: 1
    secrets:
      REGISTRY_USER: {store: vault, key: REGISTRY_USER, field: value}
      REGISTRY_PASSWORD: {store: vault, key: REGISTRY_PASSWORD, field: value}
    run: |
      docker login -u $REGISTRY_USER -p $REGISTRY_PASSWORD $CI_REGISTRY
      docker push $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$LAUNCHWAY_TAG
    fetch:
      - {from: build, name: binaries}
